page_title: WOL 1-1 BOC | Wolfsburg v Bochum 22/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Georgios Masouras as he is replaced by Cristian Gamboa (Bochum).
90+4' Dieter Hecking decides to make a substitution. Ibrahima Sissoko will be replaced by Anthony Losilla (Bochum).
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' It's like he was asking for a caution. Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) receives a yellow card.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mohamed Amoura leaves the pitch and Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg) comes on.
87' A goal, which was scored by Georgios Masouras (Bochum), was disallowed due to offside.
86' Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
85' Here is a change. Philipp Hofmann is going off and Dieter Hecking gives the last tactical orders to Moritz Broschinski (Bochum).
81' 1 - 1 Goal 1:1! Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
81' Wolfsburg will take a corner kick.

79' Nice move, nice attempt! Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.
79' Wolfsburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
78' Problems for Dieter Hecking as Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Maximilian Wittek replaces him.
76' Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
75' Bochum seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

73' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball goes out of play and Bochum will have a goal kick.
72' Ivan Ordets (Bochum) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
71' The Wolfsburg players are exchanging some short passes.
70' Ball possession – 50:50.
69' A cross into the box from Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) is cleared.
67' The Wolfsburg players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
66' The referee is firm and issues Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) a deserved yellow card.
65' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal due to a foul. The Wolfsburg players look gutted.
65' The Wolfsburg players halt their celebrations as referee Timo Gerach makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
64' Goal! Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot into the top right corner. It's 1:1.
63' Bence Dardai (Wolfsburg) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Aster Vranckx.
63' Ralph Hasenhuttl has decided to substitute Patrick Wimmer and he is replaced by Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg).
63' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) plays a through ball but overhits it.
59' The Wolfsburg players are exchanging some short passes.
58' That's the end of the game for Mads Roerslev Rasmussen, who is replaced by Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg).
58' Ralph Hasenhuttl has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Andreas Skov Olsen (Wolfsburg) replacing Tiago Tomas.
55' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 1:5.
54' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
51' Wolfsburg control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

50' 0 - 1 Erhan Masovic (Bochum) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the right side of the goal. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 0:1.
49' The corner is swung in but Bochum can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
48' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bochum comes to nothing.
47' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) is able to continue to play.
45+1' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
42' Bochum take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
41' Wolfsburg are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
39' 4:4 – the total goal attempt statistics.

36' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
36' Bochum have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
34' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
33' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
31' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) picks up an injury.
29' Great teamplay by Wolfsburg as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
29' Shots on target – 3:2.
28' Bochum failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

28' Georgios Masouras (Bochum) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Marius Muller shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net. It will be a corner kick for Bochum.
27' That's unlucky! Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
27' A pass by Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
26' The Wolfsburg players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
25' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
22' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Wolfsburg.
21' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom left corner, but Timo Horn was alert and the score remains the same.
20' The Bochum players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
19' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
18' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 1:4.
17' Neat passing move from Wolfsburg in order to create new attacking opportunities.
14' Bochum seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

11' Georgios Masouras (Bochum) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom left corner is blocked by Marius Muller, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
11' 70:30 – the latest ball possession ratio.
9' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Wolfsburg.
7' That's a clear yellow card. Matus Bero (Bochum) goes into the book.
6' Wolfsburg enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
5' Tim Oermann (Bochum) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
4' An attempted cross from Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) is cleared.
3' Tom Krauss (Bochum) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. Wolfsburg earn a free kick.
2' Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. Wolfsburg will have a throw-in.
1' The match has just started.
Bochum will kick the game off.
Timo Gerach will officiate today.
